Yes. Based on specialization, Texas-wide telehealth, and ERP training, **my first recommendation would be Lukas Snear, LPC, NCC, at Azimuth OCD and Anxiety**. He focuses exclusively on OCD, provides telehealth throughout Texas, uses ERP across OCD subtypes, and lists BTTI training. He also offers family therapy and sliding-fee scholarships. ([iocdf.org](https://iocdf.org/providers/snear-lukas/?utm_source=openai))

Other strong options:

- **Austin Daron, LPC, LCPC** — Offers individual telehealth for adults, specializes in ERP for OCD, and describes the practice as entirely focused on OCD and related disorders. He is neurodiversity- and LGBTQIA+-affirming. ([iocdf.org](https://iocdf.org/providers/daron-austin/?utm_source=openai))
- **Lindy Noll, LCSW** — Provides virtual therapy for adults across Texas, with ERP and additional OCD-focused training and consultation. ([iocdf.org](https://iocdf.org/providers/noll-lindy/?utm_source=openai))
- **Saharah Shrout, MA, LPC-S** — A Houston-area OCD specialist who treats adults and adolescents through telehealth; her background includes the Menninger Clinic OCD Program, Houston OCD Program, ERP, BTTI, and B4DT training. ([iocdf.org](https://iocdf.org/providers/shrout-saharah/?utm_source=openai))
- **Dr. Chad Brandt, PhD** — A Texas-licensed psychologist offering ERP for OCD via telehealth; he has specialized training and fellowship experience through the Houston OCD Program. ([drchadbrandt.com](https://www.drchadbrandt.com/?utm_source=openai))
- **Kimberly Wilson, LPC, LMFT** — Offers virtual OCD treatment for adults, children, and families, including ERP, CBT, ACT, and family-based interventions. ([iocdf.org](https://iocdf.org/providers/wilson-kimberly/?utm_source=openai))

The providers above are listed in the International OCD Foundation directory, which says that provider licensure and BTTI completion are verified, although the individual listings themselves are self-reported. ([iocdf.org](https://iocdf.org/providers/noll-lindy/?utm_source=openai))

When contacting them, ask:

1. “Do you treat **OCD primarily with ERP**, rather than general anxiety therapy?”
2. “Do you provide **telehealth for someone located anywhere in Texas**?”
3. “Do you accept my insurance, and what is the private-pay rate?”
4. “Do you treat my particular presentation—such as Pure O, relationship OCD, scrupulosity, harm OCD, contamination, health anxiety, or postpartum OCD?”

Availability and insurance participation can change, so confirm those details directly.
